lines.zh: 我没有脚步声，只有摩擦。
lines.en: I have no footfall. Only a friction.

lines.zh: 我从墙角过去，墙没有动。
lines.en: I pass the corner and the wall does not move.

lines.zh: 我走路的方向永远对着你。
lines.en: The way I walk always points at you.

lines.zh: 我的身形不太清楚，边缘在抖。
lines.en: My outline is unclear; the edges tremble.
I walk and whisper at the same time.
You cannot make out what I am saying.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，灰尘浮起来。
lines.en: Where I pass, dust lifts.
I hug the wall like a shadow.

lines.zh: 我的步子不快，距离却在缩短。
lines.en: My steps are slow, yet the distance shrinks.

lines.zh: 我从走廊那头过来，一直没停。
lines.en: I have come from the far end without stopping.
I stand there. Not moving, not leaving.
I keep speaking, very low.
The dark in the corner is deeper than elsewhere.
I watch, though I have no eyes.

lines.zh: 角落里没有呼吸声，只有我。
lines.en: There is no breathing in this corner but mine.

lines.zh: 我的形状和墙角重合了。
lines.en: My shape merges with the corner.
Listen. I have started speaking again.
I wait for you to look back on your own.

lines.zh: 我的声音像有人在你耳边。
lines.en: My voice sounds like someone at your ear.
I hold this shape for a long while.
However fast you go, it does not help.

lines.zh: 我和你之间的距离是固定的。
lines.en: The distance between us stays fixed.
I do not come in. I wait.
You turn. I do not retreat.
You look at me. I keep approaching.
Your gaze does nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我的脸在动，但看不出表情。
lines.en: My face moves, but shows nothing.

lines.zh: 你举起武器，我还在往前走。
lines.en: You raise a weapon. I am still walking.

lines.zh: 我叫了你的名字，用你的声音。
lines.en: I say your name in your own voice.

lines.zh: 你退到光里，我也跟进去。
lines.en: You retreat into the light. I follow.
I do not blink. I do not breathe.

lines.zh: 你又数了一次距离，还是那样。
lines.en: You measure the distance again. Unchanged.

lines.zh: 你听我说话，就会停下来。
lines.en: If you listen to me, you will stop.

lines.zh: 我越来越清楚，也越来越近。
lines.en: I grow clearer, and nearer.

lines.zh: 你看我第二眼时，我近了一步。
lines.en: On your second look, I am one step nearer.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里，你的眼里没有我。
lines.en: I am in your sight. There is nothing in yours.

lines.zh: 我没有脸，你还是看得出我在笑。
lines.en: I have no face, yet you can tell I am smiling.
My whisper breaks for a beat.
My outline blurs.

lines.zh: 我被劈开，两边都在看你。
lines.en: Cut in two, both halves watch you.
I retreat, but not far.
My voice turns rough.

lines.zh: 我少了一只手臂，很快又有了。
lines.en: I lose an arm. It returns quickly.

lines.zh: 墙角暗了一下，我在那里。
lines.en: The corner darkens. I am there.
I stop, then continue forward.
I do not feel pain. I am only slower.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，留着自己用。
lines.en: Whatever you hold, keep for yourself.

lines.zh: 你放下的东西，我还是不收。
lines.en: You put it down. I still do not take it.
You want to trade it for my leaving.
I am not leaving. I am right here.
You back three steps holding it up.
I have not slowed a step.

lines.zh: 这东西在你手里，也在我嘴里。
lines.en: It is in your hand. It is also in my mouth.
Do you hear the chewing.
Put it down. It will not help.
You walk into me. Cold.

lines.zh: 我从你身上穿过去，又在你身后。
lines.en: I pass through you and am behind you again.

lines.zh: 我的手搭在你肩上，很轻。
lines.en: My hand rests on your shoulder, very light.
We never truly touch.
My edge brushes your face.
You hit the wall. I am not in it.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离又恢复了。
lines.en: The distance between us resets.

lines.zh: 你听见一声很长的呼气。
lines.en: You hear a long exhale.

lines.zh: 另一个声音在走廊那头应我。
lines.en: Another voice answers me down the hall.

lines.zh: 我们两个念着同一句话。
lines.en: We both recite the same words.

lines.zh: 我们站在两端，中间没有路。
lines.en: We stand at opposite ends, no path between.
They have no face either.

lines.zh: 我们的声音叠在一起，变成一种。
lines.en: Our voices overlap into one.
We retreat into the wall together.
They know what I know.
We do not need to come closer.
Two shadows become one.
We were never apart.
I do not pick things up.
It is in my hand, and not.

lines.zh: 它从你手里到了我这儿。
lines.en: It has gone from your hand to mine.
I did not come for this.
It turns cold in my hand.
I squeeze it. It does not change.

lines.zh: 我把它举起来，你不知道我在看什么。
lines.en: I lift it. You cannot tell what I am looking at.
It falls; the sound comes from far away.
I leave no prints.
I chose you long ago.

lines.zh: 你听见的那句低语，是我在叫你。
lines.en: That whisper you heard was me calling.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，把我从角落里叫醒。
lines.en: Your footsteps wake me from my corner.
I do not need to see you.

lines.zh: 你的位置，我一直都知道。
lines.en: I always know your position.
I speed up a little. Only a little.

lines.zh: 灯闪的时候，我到了更近的地方。
lines.en: When the light flickers, I am nearer.

lines.zh: 你在数我的脚步，数不清吧。
lines.en: You are counting my steps. They do not add up.

lines.zh: 我把你的名字念了一遍。
lines.en: I say your name once.
That cold behind you is me.
I have started speaking. Do not listen.

lines.zh: 我的声音从两边同时来。
lines.en: My voice comes from both sides at once.
You truly need not run.
Doors do not stop me.
I am only a few steps away.

lines.zh: 你把背靠在墙上，墙也是我的。
lines.en: You put your back to the wall. The wall is mine too.
I am in no hurry, and I will not leave.
I have followed without a break.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪，我都在你身后同一步。
lines.en: Wherever you run, I am the same step behind.

lines.zh: 你把门锁上，我还在门外说。
lines.en: You lock the door. I keep whispering outside.
I need no speed. I only need to be here.
You look back. The distance has not changed.

lines.zh: 你越跑，呼吸越响，我听得越清楚。
lines.en: The more you run, the louder your breath, the clearer to me.

lines.zh: 我穿过墙，从另一边出来。
lines.en: I cross the wall and come out the other side.

lines.zh: 灯举得再高，也照不全我站的地方。
lines.en: Raise the lamp as high as you like; it never reaches my corner.
I herd you one way.

lines.zh: 我不用伸手，你也会过来。
lines.en: I need not reach out. You will come.
You should not have listened to me.
Every step, I am behind you.

lines.zh: 我把出口那面的光挡住了。
lines.en: I have blocked the light from the exit.
I do not shout. I only speak.
I say your name slowly.

lines.zh: 走廊变长了，你没发现吗。
lines.en: The corridor has lengthened. Did you notice.

lines.zh: 你每转一次身，我就近一寸。
lines.en: Each time you turn, I close in an inch.
My hand is on your shoulder.
I press close, cold to the bone.

lines.zh: 你听见的最后一个声音是我的低语。
lines.en: The last thing you hear is my whisper.
I take you from behind.

lines.zh: 你挥了一下，什么都没碰到。
lines.en: You swing. You touch nothing.
I draw you toward the wall.

lines.zh: 我的手指从你颈后划过。
lines.en: My fingers pass the back of your neck.
You fall. I am right beside you.

lines.zh: 我的声音钻进你的耳朵。
lines.en: My voice works its way into your ear.

lines.zh: 我没有重量，却压得你抬不起手。
lines.en: I have no weight, yet you cannot lift your arms.
You pull back. I am behind you again.
My outline closes around you.
I am a hand's width from your face.
A little more dark appears in the corner.
I begin to speak, very softly.

lines.zh: 我从你身后那面墙里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the wall behind you.
The air here drops a degree.
First I learn the sound of your steps.
I take shape in the darkest place.

lines.zh: 没有光的地方，我就到了。
lines.en: Where there is no light, I arrive.
I slowly gain an outline.
I know which room you are in.
I recite a name to myself.
I spread out along the floor.
The moment I appear, the lights dim.
I am not hurried. First, I watch.
I wait a while in the corner.
My whisper arrives first; then I do.

lines.zh: 这里的每一面墙都记下了我。
lines.en: Every wall here has recorded me.
I begin counting your steps.
You have not noticed that I have come.

lines.zh: 火光把我的形状照散了。
lines.en: Firelight scatters my shape.

lines.zh: 我落下去，然后在下面等你。
lines.en: I fall, then wait for you below.

lines.zh: 水里有声音，我听得更清楚。
lines.en: Sound carries in water. I hear it clearer.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我撕开，我又合上。
lines.en: The blast tears me apart; I rejoin.
Something passes through me and falls.
That light pushes me back a stretch.

lines.zh: 我不会饿，我只是越来越淡。
lines.en: I do not hunger. I only fade.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮我，我讨厌被看清。
lines.en: The lightning shows me. I hate being seen.
In the dark I am clearer.
